title: Helion Energy machine cards
description: A near-black band with a centred mono eyebrow and uppercase heading over two 480px photo cards with 8px corners and a 40% dark scrim, the first about twice as wide as the second (stacked on phones). Each card carries a name and one short line top-left and a square outlined arrow button bottom-left. The photos settle from 110% as they arrive and a fill sweeps across each arrow button with the scroll.
notes: built for two cards (a 879:429 split on desktop); more cards wrap into the same two columns
media is each card's photo or film; empty, a dark placeholder
